storyCards.headline: Why Can't This Be Love: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Van Halen's "Why Can't This Be Love" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

Why Can't This Be Love was released in 1986.
